item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Harsh heating solid butter in a dish. A thermometer is placed in the butter. At one fixed temperature the solid butter turns into liquid butter.

Which claim is correct?

options.A: Heating makes the particles vibrate more until they leave fixed positions; that temperature is the melting point at atmospheric pressure.
options.B: Heating packs the particles closer until they stop vibrating; that temperature is the melting point.
options.C: Heating turns the solid butter straight into vapour; the melting point is the boiling temperature.
options.D: The butter melts at any temperature as soon as Harsh stirs it.
